articles.title: 发布约 2 年后，特斯拉自动驾驶出租车 Cybercab 本月有望迎来首次公众试乘
articles.content: IT之家 8 月 21 日消息，科技媒体 The Information 昨日（8 月 20 日）发布博文，援引匿名消息源称特斯拉计划本月（2026 年 8 月）底向公众开放 Cybercab 试乘，接入美国得州奥斯汀的 Robotaxi 自动驾驶出租车服务（主要为 Model Y 车型）。在 2024 年 10 月召开的“WE,REBOT”活动，特斯拉正式宣布自动驾驶出租车 CyberCab，专为完全自动驾驶（无人驾驶）场景设计。报道指出在过去几个月里，特斯拉一直在公共道路测试 Cybercab，并于上月（2026 年 7 月）让员工在奥斯汀总部附近的私有道路乘坐 Cybercab。消息源还透露特斯拉近期已面向奥斯汀各地的急救人员完成培训，内容聚焦 Cybercab 相关事故和应急处置问题。IT之家查询公开资料，摩根大通分析师拉贾特 · 古普塔（Rajat Gupta）发布研报，指出特斯拉目前正在有意控制 Model Y 进入其 Robotaxi 服务的数量，从而扩大增加 Cybercab 部署规模。在系统方面，特斯拉向摩根大通表示，FSD V15 将会带来显著性能提升，该版本涵盖 7 项核心技术，其中约 40% 已在现役 Robotaxi 车队测试，初步反馈积极。特斯拉管理层将 FSD V15 称为扩大无人监督 FSD 服务的主要入口。特斯拉称，现有 AI / HW4 算力组合能够运行 V15，并支持无人监督 FSD。

articles.title: 马自达申请转子发动机废气再循环专利，瞄准量产排放难题
articles.content: IT之家 8 月 21 日消息，汽车媒体 CarScoops 昨日（8 月 20 日）发布博文，报道称马自达（Mazda）向美国商标和专利局（USPTO）提交申请，描述了面向转子发动机的废气再循环系统。马自达曾推出 Iconic SP（2023 年日本车展首秀）和 Vision X-Coupe（2025 年日本车展首秀）两款概念车，释放复兴转子发动机的信号，但想要打造搭载转子发动机的量产车依然存在诸多挑战。该专利主要介绍了废气再循环系统，将转子壳体的排气通道分配给 2 类排气口：侧向排气口：排出的废气将流向涡轮增压器周边排气口：废气则流入发动机并经过废气再循环（EGR）冷却器，从而降低进气温度。IT之家援引博文介绍，在高负载工况下，发动机不需要依靠废气再循环降低排放。此时，经冷却的气体可以直接输送至第二级催化转化器。该设计试图兼顾排放控制、进气温度与发动机动力需求。Iconic SP转子发动机（Wankel Engine）用旋转运动代替了传统活塞的往复运动，具有体积小、重量轻、高转速和功率强大的核心优势。它不需要复杂的曲柄连杆机构，在输出同样功率时，它的体积和重量远小于传统的往复式活塞发动机。

articles.title: 爱奇艺 CEO 龚宇：将坚定 All in AI 战略，同时全力推进非中心化社交媒体转型
articles.content: IT之家 8 月 21 日消息，爱奇艺创始人、CEO 龚宇在昨日举行的爱奇艺创作者大会上强调，平台将坚定 All in AI 战略，深耕 AI 赋能实拍与 AIGC 影视长片创作，同时全力推进非中心化社交媒体转型。这两大战略双向赋能，持续降低内容创作门槛，壮大创作者队伍，激活平台内容活力，形成发展飞轮。龚宇认为，没必要再讨论人是否会被 AI 取代，“AI 只会取代不会用 AI 的人”这句话已经是鸡汤。AI 就像人类历史上的伟大发明一样，对社会的影响没有差别，但 AI 确实解放了影视创作者的束缚。据IT之家此前报道，今年 4 月，龚宇曾表示，面对 AI 带来的变革，爱奇艺顺势而为的应对方式是去中心化，从传统少数人决定观众喜好的模式，转向创作者与用户社区。龚宇此前表示，AI 技术将大幅降低内容制作成本与周期，创作者数量和作品数量可能增长百倍以上，中心化决策将无法应对。因此，爱奇艺必须向非中心化转型，打造一个创作者与用户的社区。播放器将降级为一个组件，更多创作者可自主上传作品，通过会员、广告等方式直接变现。平台后退一步，不过爱奇艺仍会保留部分头部内容制作。相关阅读：《爱奇艺 2026 财年第二财季归母净亏损 2.88 亿元，同比扩大 115.02%》《爱奇艺宣布 10 部 AIGC 电影进入成片制作阶段，奥斯卡最佳摄影得主鲍德熹负责指导》

articles.title: Active Inference as Context Acquisition for AI Agents
articles.content:
arXiv:2608.19202v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Interactive AI agents must acquire the right context as efficiently as possible. When a user omits a constraint, preference, file, or task variable, an agent can proceed with a default assumption or spend tokens on a clarifying question, retrieval call, tool call, or prompt trial. We formulate this tradeoff as active inference for context acquisition. An inner inference step updates beliefs over a latent task state, and an outer decision selects the next context action, task action, or stop action to minimize expected free energy under cost. In deterministic settings, the epistemic term reduces to expected information gain, optionally normalized by token cost. articles.title: How to Navigate Uncertainty About AI Consciousness
articles.content:
arXiv:2608.19215v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Given deep uncertainty about the possibility of artificial consciousness, it is unclear how we should treat potentially sentient AI. On the one hand, we could assume insentience but risk doing terrible harms to entities that deserve moral standing. On the other hand, we could assume sentience and instead risk wasting resources on insentient machines. The intractability of questions around AI consciousness mean that this dilemma is hard to escape. I suggest a way out of that shifts from intractable questions of AI consciousness to tractable questions of AI valence. Specifically, we can assess whether an AI has states that would constitute valenced experiences if it were conscious. I show how this is sufficient to ground a responsible approach to the development of potentially conscious AI.

articles.content:
arXiv:2608.19216v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: AI control research asks how to deploy models safely even when they may be misaligned, but many control protocols assume that the deployer can instrument the model and its surrounding pipeline. That assumption often fails for regulated organisations using frontier models through APIs or managed endpoints, where the deployer may control the business process but not the model weights, serving infrastructure, internal traces, update process, or full interaction logs. articles.content:
arXiv:2608.19299v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Air traffic control (ATC) communication is a safety-critical dialogue that remains largely human-driven even as other parts of air traffic management have been semi-automated. In this article, we experimentally evaluate whether large language models (LLMs) can generate operationally realistic ATC transmissions. Abstract: Prosodic cues can convey task-relevant information that alters the trajectory and outcome of a task-oriented dialogue, even when the words themselves remain unchanged. Abstract: A fundamental challenge in robotic teleoperation is enabling an operator to control a remote robot as effortlessly and intuitively as their own hands. Abstract: Thanks to its parallelizability and flexibility, sampling-based Model Predictive Control (MPC) has become widely popular for controlling real-world robotic systems.
